newsitem.title: USA: WCI Steel Inc OKs plan to go private.
newsitem.headline: WCI Steel Inc OKs plan to go private.

text.p: WCI Steel Inc said Wednesday its board has approved a proposal to go private for $10 per share.
The company's major shareholder, Renco Group Inc, which owns 84 percent of WCI's common stock, has agreed to buy all of the rest of the shares it doesn't now own.

The board of directors also approved a proposal from Renco that WCI offer to purchase all, but not less than a majority, of its outstanding 10-1/2 percent senior notes due 2002 at a purchase price of 111.5 percent plus accrued interest.
It also will place an offering of $300 million of new senior notes.
The move to go private is not contigent on the debt offer and refinancing. However, the debt offer and refinancing are contingent on the privatization.
